## Overview

In Assignment 9, scikit-learn trained the neural networks for you. In this assignment you will use **PyTorch**, the library behind most modern deep learning, and write the training loop yourself. You will then use it to study the two things that matter most when training a deep network: the **learning rate** and **overfitting**.

The data is scikit-learn's built-in handwritten digits (1,797 images of 8×8 pixels), so nothing needs to be downloaded.

## What to Submit

Submit the completed notebook `assignment10_student.ipynb` on Canvas, with all cells run.

You can run the notebook on your laptop (install PyTorch with `pip install torch`) or on [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com), where PyTorch is already installed. The whole notebook runs in under a minute on a laptop CPU.

## The Questions

| Question | Topic |
|---|---|
| 1 | Split the data into training/validation/test sets and create a `DataLoader` |
| 2 | Define a network with two hidden layers in PyTorch |
| 3 | Write the training loop: forward pass, loss, zero the gradients, backpropagation, update |
| 4 | Epochs, mini-batches and weight updates |
| 5 | Compare learning rates 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 and 1.0 |
| 6 | Overfitting on a small training set; dropout, weight decay and early stopping |
| 7 | Train a final model and evaluate it once on the test set |

## AI Policy

You may use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot). Include a short statement describing how you used them and anything they got wrong that you had to fix.
